briefdescription.para: Provide access to the Option info table.

detaileddescription.para: The OptTable class provides a layer of indirection which allows Option instance to be created lazily. In the common case, only a few options will be needed at runtime; the OptTable class maintains enough information to parse command lines without instantiating Options, while letting other parts of the driver still use Option instances where convenient.
